daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Pisces. Trust those gut feelings that pop up randomly—they're basically your soul's way of sliding into your DMs with important info. Channel that dreamy energy into something real.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person needs to hear something vulnerable from you rn. Single? Someone's been lowkey noticing your energy. Either way, authenticity is your superpower today. Let them see the real you.
daily.career: Your ideas have legs today, even the ones that feel a little out there. Don't water them down for the room. Pitch that thing, send that email, speak up in that meeting. Your vision matters more than you think.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness and flow rather than intensity. Think yoga, walking, swimming—anything that feels like moving through water instead of fighting it. Rest isn't lazy; it's productive magic.

weekly.overview: Mercury's dancing through your zone of creativity this week, Pisces. Your intuition is basically your superpower rn—trust those gut feelings even if they seem random. Energy's shifting toward authenticity, so lean into what actually feels real to you.
